method: Every feature bucketed into deciles; each decile scored on close-to-close return, on best and worst excursion inside the window, and on the probability of clearing 25/50/100bp. Ranked by the separation between the top and bottom deciles in standard errors of the difference.

cost.note: Delayed-entry only: 5.55bp. Roll had non-negative covariance, so momentum dominates the bounce at this resolution.
